inbox_ios_tour_menu_text: The left icon switches directly between list and tiles. Next to it, the menu: light/dark, view, plain design, font size, and the settings.
inbox_ios_tour_ask_text: Ask the AI free-form questions in the search bar – for example “How much did I spend at Amazon this month?”. Enter starts the AI; it searches your mailbox and reads the matching mails when needed.
inbox_ios_tour_ai_text: The AI button summarizes your whole day or all unread mails at a glance – tap any line to open the mail.
